hints.title: Array Length Condition
hints.text: An array of length n must be a permutation of base[n - 1].

hints.title: Base Array Frequencies
hints.text: In base[m], integers from 1 to m - 1 appear once each, and integer m appears twice.

hints.title: Count Verification
hints.text: Count occurrences of all values and ensure they match the required frequencies exactly.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash map frequency checking against the base permutation requirements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting the array takes O(n log n) whereas frequency counting achieves linear time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) time and O(n) space using frequency mapping.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Validate size constraints and exact frequency distributions for each target value.
